description: This file implements a statistics management system for Zephyr OS, including functions for initializing, registering, walking, and resetting statistic structures, as well as managing a global list of statistic groups.

methods.name: stats_get_name
methods.description: Retrieves the name of a statistic at a given index within a stats header, optionally using a name map if CONFIG_STATS_NAMES is enabled.

methods.name: stats_get_off
methods.description: Calculates the offset of a statistic at a given index within a stats header.

methods.name: stats_gen_name
methods.description: Generates a default name for unnamed statistics in the format 's<index>'.

methods.name: stats_walk
methods.description: Walks through each statistic entry in a stats header, calling a user-provided function for each.

methods.name: stats_init
methods.description: Initializes a stats header with size, count, and optional name map, then resets it.

methods.name: stats_group_walk
methods.description: Iterates over all registered stats groups, calling a user-provided function for each.

methods.name: stats_group_get_next
methods.description: Returns the next stats header in the list after the given one.

methods.name: stats_group_find
methods.description: Finds a stats header by name in the global list.

methods.name: stats_register
methods.description: Registers a new stats header with a unique name into the global list.

methods.name: stats_init_and_reg
methods.description: Initializes and registers a stats header with specified parameters.

methods.name: stats_reset
methods.description: Resets and zeroes the data in a stats header.
